sentences.text: Leivanectes is a genus of plesiosaurs, marine reptiles belonging to the family Elasmosauridae.
The genus name honors the location Villa de Leiva.
The only known species, L. bernadoi, was described in 2019 after remains were found in the Paja Formation near Villa de Leyva in the Boyaca department of Colombia.
Fossils of Leivanectes come from Late Aptian marine deposits in central Colombia, where the animal lived between 119.57 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
